program.name: Strength & Stretch Volume
program.subject: Strength & stretch
program.blurb: Three days of lifting, each followed by a flow for the muscles you just worked.
program.about: A three-day rotation of strength and stretching. Presses lead into a chest and shoulder opener, squats and hinges into a hip flow, and rows and pull-ups into a spine flow. Every session lifts hard first and lengthens after. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Push & chest opener / legs & hip flow / pull & spine flow
